rationale: Corrected observation for the same unit and obligation, replacing the artifact whose accept-round property was shown to observe the wrong round. The harness now drives every queued round explicitly and re-reads the record after each delivery, so the accept count and the final status come from the record currently in InstanceSpace; the plan keeps the reviewed adoption property and replaces the unreached accept-round property with an outcome property that compares the vector the recoverer commits with the vector the already-committed replica holds. The local construction run shows the recoverer reaching COMMITTED with a NOOP command while the peer holds a PUT, i.e. two different committed vectors for one instance, but the formal observation is left to the trusted runner.
